notes: Reconciled against .claude/reports/2026-10-17-focus-indicator/C-sgs-inventory.md (report C: 330 shipped front-end rules in 81 files, 168 indicator rules, 67 distinct forms in 64 files), rule by rule, by matching path plus whitespace-free selector against report C's own scan output (its scratchpad rows.json).

Rules: 329 here in report C's scope (CSS and SCSS outside editor.css / editor.scss) against 330. Minus 2: both rules of a git-ignored per-client stylesheet in theme/sgs-theme/styles/ (.gitignore theme/sgs-theme/styles/*.css) that report C read from the working tree and this corpus never sees (git ls-files). Plus 1: responsive-logo/style.scss's '&__link:hover, &__link:focus-visible' rule, which report C's scan merged into its neighbour because it stripped only /* */ comments, so SCSS // comment text became part of 10 of its SCSS selectors (timeline/style.scss and responsive-logo/style.scss); those 10 match here by position. Files: 80 against 81, the git-ignored file.

Editor CSS: report C excluded the 32 rules in editor.css and editor.scss; they are counted here (group editor, 39 CSS rules with the component, admin and motion-thumbnail stylesheets), so all CSS rules total 361.

Indicator rules: 171 here (bespoke, allow and shared-outline items that draw outline or box-shadow on a focus selector) against 168. Report C's 168 split here into 163 bespoke, 3 allow (SavedPostPicker, motion-thumbnails, customiser button presets), 1 shared-outline (product-card's :hover / :focus-within / :focus-visible outline-color) and 1 in the git-ignored file. The 4 extra: the 3 rules report C called suppress (outline: none with a box-shadow ring: WooCommerce text inputs and two client-notes inputs) draw the ring with box-shadow and are bespoke here; .sgs-form-field__input:focus:not(:focus-visible), which report C called resting, paints an outline on pointer focus and is bespoke here.

Distinct forms: 69 here over those 171 rules against 67. Forms here are the full outline*, box-shadow, --sgs-focus-shadow and border-radius declarations in source order, lower-cased and whitespace-normalised. Report C's own formula (gen.py::short: fixed property order, token chains abbreviated, values truncated at 95 characters) over these 171 rules gives 68; the 1 left is the four added rules minus the git-ignored one. Files with an indicator: 64, the same as report C. The survey's ratchet line 'distinct indicator forms' counts only forms still drawn by a target (bespoke, php-emitter, js-emitter, json-focus, editor included) and is the number Task 15 drives to the system's own.

Categories beyond the plan's §3 list, each documented in classify-css.js: shared-outline (an outline on a :hover + :focus pair; allowed and listed, never auto-deleted because that would delete the hover effect), resting-outline (an outline on a selector with no positive focus state: invalid inputs, the client-notes highlight, contrast.css's prefers-contrast: high baseline, editor block-selection chrome, and outline: none on a non-focusable subject), and js-emitter (the JS twin of php-emitter: the motion editor-canvas Focus state).

suppress is limited to a focus selector or a resting selector whose subject looks focusable (selector.js::subjectFocusable); a :focus-within or :has( :focus… ) ring is bespoke when its subject is itself a control (wp-block-navigation__responsive-close) and container otherwise.

PHP and JS: every statement whose strings mention :focus is one item, classified from the CSS it assembles (lexer.js::reconstruct) or its shape (a pairing helper, a :hover pair, :focus-within, :not( :focus… )); 4 statements need emitter-registry.json, each with a reason. php-emitter: the sgs-accessibility skip link, the two nav submenu rules in includes/nav-menu-submenu-link-css.php and the form Focus state suffix in includes/motion/class-sgs-motion-focus-state.php.

Corpus control: the dumb count of ':focus' substrings over the corpus (802) equals the classified mentions (629) plus comments (163), the second and later mentions inside one PHP or JS statement (9) and one registered runtime query (1); every file reconciles exactly. The wide enumeration (every tracked text source mentioning :focus or a retired token) has nothing outside the corpus without a WIDTH_OK reason.

baselineMeta.shape: Ratcheted ceiling (migration-method Step 8). Keys are content keys 'category | path | context | selector | property' with a count. --check fails on a finding above its count and on an entry no longer reproduced; --prune-baseline lowers entries to the live count and never adds or raises one. Written once from the 2026-10-17 census (Task 1); each focus task prunes it; Task 15 deletes this file and the gate becomes binary.
